notes.title: Trading Cards and Bug Fixes for Hazel Sky!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Engineers![/h2]

 We have a major update for Hazel Sky, containing plenty of bug fixes, translation fixes for other languages, and Steam Trading Cards to collect and remember your adventure by.

Thank you very much for your love and support for Hazel Sky!

The full patch notes can be found below. 


[u][b]Changelist to patch version 1.0.10[/b][/u]
•	Fixed: Game break checkpoint airplane(obstacle that need to be destroyed by the cannon).
The player can overlap airplane's area checkpoint (without using the cannon to destroy the airplane) and get stuck in the airplane when the respawn happens.
•	Fixed: Wrong translations in texture of glider blueprint. Languages: de, ja, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans.
•	Fixed: Tower game start sequence. The player can jump when animation of remove blindfold is playing.
•	Collision Polish: First island ropes.
•	Collision Polish: Watch tower character stuck.
•	Fixed: Trinket whale appearing in the menu gallery but not in the game.
•	Fixed: Inconsistent player land from garage roof to the ground close to the ropes.
•	Fixed: Inconsistent shark death when you already dead by drowning.
•	Fixed: Inexistent item between the scarred cigarette pack and the cookie removed from gallery.
•	Polish: Starfish more visible.
•	Polish: Inconsistent scale of the first skeleton at right of the bridge in erin transition 2.
•	Fixed: Inconsistent trigger to avid reader achievement.
•	Polish: Inconsistent physics responses of interactable planks.
•	Collision Polish: Broken boat in island 1.
•	Collision Polish: Skeleton near to boat in island 1.
•	Polish: Well slide area.
•	Fixed: Inconsistent trigger of collectible achievements.
•	Fixed: Game breaking when exit program during finish interaction of the underwater fuse in the slot.
•	Polish: Japanese translations.
•	Fixed: Shane's teeth is visible when interact with the lock underwater.
•	Fixed: Unable to grab underwater fuse after quit application without pass by default end play procedure.
•	Polish: Collisions in ship on the shore.
•	Fixed: Once Player was unable to enter in balloon.

notes.title: ⚙️An Update from Gideon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36914076/d85c8899b1f86b188631655c7c4aecf6f96294a4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings Engineers![/h1]

We are very excited to update you with some of the things that we’ve been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36914076/9f6a9eb0a03443592ffc4c6d250549cd1ef61bc3.png[/img]

[u][b]1.	Brazilian Portuguese and English Voice Acting[/b][/u]

One of the most requested features we’ve had since the beginning of Hazel Sky’s development was Voice Acting and we are pleased to say that we have secured incredibly voice actors in our native language, Brazilian Portuguese, and English! We will have more information to share on this soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36914076/9f6a9eb0a03443592ffc4c6d250549cd1ef61bc3.png[/img]

[u][b]2.	Nearly Completed our First End-to-End build[/b][/u]

How exciting is that! We are rapidly approaching an end-to-end build and content lock! This is a major milestone for us and a significant step along our journey to bring Hazel Sky to a platform near you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36914076/9f6a9eb0a03443592ffc4c6d250549cd1ef61bc3.png[/img]

[u][b]3.	Covid19 Issues and Realities[/b][/u]

We are fortunate enough to not have been significantly slowed down by Covid19 but we have had issues receiving certain equipment that may lead to delays on other platforms. Time will tell. So far, we are lucky, healthy, and fed up of working from home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36914076/9cf6fb3082fa699625ba4be55a7bfdc4671e2706.png[/img]

This is a short summary of where we are at with the game and we hope that your enjoyed it! We will have more information soon!
